user.title: Pair AmPly on Windows
user.description: Open AmPly → Options → Home Assistant and enable the controller. Enter the PC's private IPv4 address and copy its pairing key. Keep AmPly open and finish startup.

reauth_confirm.title: Update pairing key
reauth_confirm.description: Copy the current key from AmPly → Options → Home Assistant.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach AmPly. Finish startup, enable its controller, check the PC address and allow port 47824 through Windows Firewall on your private network.
error.invalid_auth: Pairing key rejected. Copy the current key from AmPly.
error.invalid_input: Use a private IPv4 address, a valid port and the full pairing key.

abort.already_configured: This AmPly player is already paired.
abort.wrong_device: This is a different AmPly player. Add it as a new integration.
